name: str-mcp-purview
description: MCP server (stdio or streamable HTTP) for Microsoft Purview data security: sensitivity labels, label policies, auto-labelling and DLP via Security & Compliance PowerShell, with Microsoft Graph only for per-user label policy settings.
author: Securing the Realm (https://securing.quest/) — Chris Lloyd-Jones (Sealjay) & Josh McDonald (KnowledgeRatio)

scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); if (fs.existsSync('.git') && fs.existsSync('.githooks')) { try { require('node:child_process').execFileSync('git', ['config', 'core.hooksPath', '.githooks'], { stdio: 'ignore' }) } catch {} }"
